name: agent-face
title: Agent Face
description: An expressive face that shows what an AI agent is doing (thinking, working, needs you, done, listening, speaking), plus an AgentStatus face with a text label. Wraps the agentfaces npm package.
docs: Usage: <AgentFace state="thinking" seed={agent.id} /> or <AgentStatus state="working" name="Ada" />. States, expressions and voice props: https://ajibadedapo.github.io/agentfaces/llms-full.txt
